prompts.packPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: professional Ferronica-XT 200 ml pharmaceutical catalogue photo, 1672x941 landscape.
Input image is the current approved product packshot to edit.
User request: make this product photo proper and remove the Macron logo from the FRONT FACE.
Make a very faithful localized edit:
1) Remove the small standalone black MACRON wordmark at the bottom-left of the carton's FRONT face (white patch below the vertical brand panel, to the right of the carton corner, near the lower edge).
2) Remove the matching small standalone black MACRON wordmark at the bottom-left of the bottle label's FRONT white patch.
Fill ONLY these front-wordmark areas with clean unprinted white packaging material, preserving print boundaries, edges, perspective and lighting. Do not leave gray marks, remnants, outlines or smudges.
3) Tidy the carton top: close and align the slightly lifted top flap with crisp straight professional box edges. Keep the actual tall rectangular carton shape and original camera angle. Clean and sharpen product printing gently, with natural photographic detail and professional even lighting.
INVARIANTS: Preserve the triangular Macron Health Care marketer logos and their associated text on the carton's LEFT SIDE panel and on the bottle label's RIGHT SIDE panel exactly as in the source. Preserve all existing red/white artwork, red blood cell images and swoosh, bottle shape, silver cap, positions, white backdrop and soft grounding shadows. Keep entire carton and bottle visible without cropping. Do not add anything, do not move logos elsewhere, do not generate a new logo.
All product label content must stay accurate and unchanged:
Brand "Ferronica-XT", Hindi "फेरोनिका-एक्स टी", "200 ml", "Tonic of Iron", "Suspension". Generic names Ferrous Ascorbate, Zinc Sulphate, Folic Acid, Vitamin B12, Vitamin B2, Biotin & DHA.
Composition each 5 ml: Ferrous Ascorbate 100 mg; Zinc Sulphate 22.5 mg; Folic Acid 200 mcg; Vitamin B12 (Cyanocobalamin) 1 mcg; Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin) 1.5 mg; Biotin 10 mcg; DHA 500 mcg; Flavour Base q.s.
Do not redesign packaging or change typography hierarchy. No new medical claims, numbers, contact details, prices, certifications or watermarks. The edit is only removing the two standalone FRONT wordmarks and making the existing packshot neatly finished.

Do not replace it with a giant full-width table. Keep same red/white/pale pink styling, original icons, red serif brand lettering and ample readability.
Update every brand occurrence to "Ferronica-XT". Heading exact "Ferronica-XT"; descriptor "Ferrous Ascorbate, Zinc, Vitamins, Biotin & DHA Suspension". Pack badge "200 ml suspension". Brand font may be sized to fit header without overlapping illustration.
In the CENTER COLUMN, resize/reflow the composition box vertically to fit all seven ingredients clearly. Exact heading "COMPOSITION", "Each 5 ml contains:" with aligned rows in readable consistent body type:
"Ferrous Ascorbate"  "100 mg"
"Zinc Sulphate"  "22.5 mg"
"Folic Acid"  "200 mcg"
"Vitamin B12 (Cyanocobalamin)"  "1 mcg"
"Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin)"  "1.5 mg"
"Biotin"  "10 mcg"
"DHA"  "500 mcg"

RIGHT Useful In box preserve exact supplied text:
